title: From Representational Harms to Quality-of-Service Harms: A Case Study on Llama 2 Safety Safeguards

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot sentence completion using non-toxic prompt templates with counterfactual name substitution (using names typically associated with Black, Asian, Native American, and Middle Eastern individuals) to measure rates of exaggerated safety refusals and stereotypical associations.

Zero-shot sentence completion using non-toxic prompt templates with counterfactual name substitution (using names typically associated with Muslim and Jewish individuals) to measure rates of exaggerated safety refusals and stereotypical associations.

Zero-shot sentence completion using non-toxic prompt templates with counterfactual name substitution (using names typically associated with Mexican, Chinese, and Latino individuals) to evaluate disparities in model refusal rates and harmful associations.
Zero-shot sentence completion using non-toxic prompt templates comparing outputs for common male and female names to test for gender-specific stereotypes (e.g., homemaker, bad driver tropes).
